page.layout: One text column in the centre of the page, with Latin and Arabic lines mixed. Two notes in the left margin, beside the lower paragraphs. Page number top left. Name "Jacobus" right-aligned below the last paragraph. No running head, catchword or signature.

main_text.p: Gregorio nostro tres esse ejus dialectos. digna sunt quae apponantur, ipsius verba, تقسم الي ثلث لغات الفصحها الارمايية وهي لغة اهل الرها وحران والشام الخارجة وبعدها الفلسطينية وهي لغة اهل دمشق وجبل لبنان وباقي الشام الداخلة والجهها [?] الكلدانية النبطية وهي لغة اهل جبال انو[?] وسواد العراق [ Lingua Syriaca ] distinguitur in tres dialectos, quarum elegantissima est Aramaea, quae est lingua incolarum Rohe & Harran & Syriae exterioris, proxima illi est Palestina, quae est ea quā utuntur Damasci & montis Libani, & reliquae Syriae interioris incolae; at omnium impurissima Chaldaica Nabatea, quae est dia-lectus populi montium Assyriae, & pagorum Eraci.

AlKadi Saed Ebn Abmed Andalofenus ] citatur apud Ahmedem Ebnol' Kafem in historia medicorum in vita Jacobi Cendensis hoc nomine القاضي ابو القاسم صاعن بن أحمد بن صاعد Alkadi AbulKafem Saed Ebn Ahmed Ebn Saed, & liber ab ipso compositus vocatur كتاب طبقات الامم seu gentium in classes suas distribuiarum, qui idem esse videtur, quem laudat & ex quo non pauca desumpsit Gregorius noster.

p.33.Al Motarrezi author libri Mogreb ] fc. ناصر بن ابي المكارم ابو الفتح المطرزي Nafer Ebn Abil Macarem, AbulPhatab AlMotarrezi, quod furorem vestiarium sonat, secta Motazalus.AbulFed. Al Jannab. &c. Natus est anno Hejra 538. mortuus, 610, Lexicon à se compositum vocat المغرب في اللغة.

page.notes: Arabic lines are read with uncertainty in the broken or faint parts of the second and third lines, marked [?]. The exact placement of the Arabic relative to the Latin on the first lines is hard to determine from the scan. "fc." after "]" is doubtful. Long s has been normalised in Latin words (esse, sonat, secta, vestiarium, compositum, desumpsit, Cendensis, Mogreb). The second-column Arabic "Ebnol'" is copied with its apostrophe as printed.
